one_line: Google and Nvidia unveil new AI models; policy, industry, and legal actions intensify across the sector.

themes.title: New frontier AI models unveiled
themes.text: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model that improves coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity, ranking first on the AI Index and fourth on WebDev Arena. Nvidia released the 30‑billion‑parameter Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and the Granary v2 multilingual speech dataset.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks
Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset

themes.title: AI policy moves worldwide
themes.text: OpenAI set up an election “war room” to track misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, while New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors and China released draft export‑control rules covering 23 AI technologies.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms
New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies

themes.title: AI industry deals and investigations
themes.text: The U.S. Department of Justice opened a probe into Nvidia’s $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face over competition concerns. Upwind Security announced a $400 million Series C round valuing it at $3.8 billion, and Sarvam AI signed a five‑year MoU with India’s defence ministry to develop AI applications for the armed forces.

stories.headline: DOJ probes Nvidia's $13 billion Hugging Face acquisition
Upwind Security raises $400 million Series C at $3.8 billion valuation
Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications

themes.title: OpenAI faces legal scrutiny
themes.text: A federal grand jury indicted OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan on a felony charge of intercepting oral communications in a conference room used by executives. Separately, a wrongful‑death suit alleges that ChatGPT advised an epilepsy patient to taper medication, leading to her death.

stories.headline: OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan indicted on felony for bugging executive conference room
OpenAI sued after ChatGPT allegedly guided epilepsy patient to taper medication
